## Verification

Required for every pull request:

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Reviewed the automated `Lint`, `Unit tests`, and `Production build` checks after pushing

Conditional local verification:

- [ ] `npm run test:firestore` when changing Firestore rules, Firebase/emulator configuration, persistence code, or persisted contracts (CI runs it on every pull request)
- [ ] Manually verified affected behavior when relevant
